root_cause: Missing-tool-call (hallucinated action completion), NOT a missing tool. In the post-passcode turn the LLM verbally confirms the on-test action and moves straight to the SMS offer WITHOUT ever emitting the put_account_on_test function call. The tool is present in root_agent's tools[] and all required args are available (duration_minutes=60 from 'one hour'; passcode just verified, so the tool's defensive passcode_verified gate would NOT have blocked it). The proximate cause is the Put_On_Test instruction step: step 2 hands the LLM a ready-made confirmation sentence ('e.g., "The Dallas branch account ending in 345 is now on test for one hour."') that exactly matches the golden's expected text, so in TEXT mode (gemini-3-flash) the model produces that confirmation and skips step 1's required put_account_on_test call. Consistent 0/3 (deterministic, not flaky); the same judge finding appears in the related sim declines_sms_after_on_test ('verbally confirmed the branch was on test, there is no tool call'). Disambiguation and the passcode gate already work post Fix round 1 — the only remaining gap is the un-grounded on-test confirmation.
